flows.name: See the current public catalog immediately
preconditions: The site is deployed from the current main branch

steps.expected: The compact Wada masthead, registry description, 21 public plugins, 160 bundled skills, and catalog controls are visible without a marketing-art hero.
steps.evidence: Rendered DOM assertion and matching-viewport screenshot

steps.expected: Search receives focus and the registry narrows to LoopKit.
steps.evidence: Browser focus and visible result assertions

steps.expected: The search clears and the full registry returns.
steps.evidence: Browser input value and result count assertions

flows.name: Inspect and copy a verified install action

steps.action: Open Harness Engineering and copy its Codex install command
steps.expected: The detail record renders and the copy control confirms the exact host-supported command.
steps.evidence: Button feedback and command text assertion

steps.expected: The Harness Engineering detail route renders its skills and package facts.

flows.name: Use the registry on a narrow screen

steps.action: Open the homepage and navigate through the catalog controls
steps.expected: The masthead, controls, rows, records, and install commands remain readable and touch-usable without horizontal overflow.

flows.name: Switch and persist the reading theme
preconditions: Paper is the default theme and local storage is empty

steps.expected: The control communicates its state and the exact Sumi tokens apply without changing catalog content.
steps.evidence: ARIA state, computed token, and screenshot assertions

steps.expected: Sumi remains active from device-local storage, then can be returned to Paper.

flows.name: Respect host support boundaries
preconditions: All-host, Codex-only, and Claude-only records exist

steps.action: Open an all-host plugin, Gauntlet Loop, and Gauntlet
steps.expected: Each page renders only the installation actions documented for that plugin’s supported hosts.

flows.name: Preserve the public export and privacy boundary
preconditions: The generated catalog reflects repository main

steps.action: Check every public record, both exports, and the excluded compatibility route
steps.expected: All 21 public routes and both exports work, the deprecated Matt package is absent from every public surface, and its route returns 404.
steps.evidence: Rendered-route suite, export scan, and anonymous request assertions
